description: Shell script for testing 'git apply' functionality with various patch application scenarios, including handling empty patches, index application, file creation, and path handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test scenario expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
